title: PearlCooldown
description: Adds a cooldown to ender pearl usage.
body:
# PearlCooldown

Adds a cooldown to ender pearl usage.

## Features
- Prevents ender pearl spam.
- Configurable cooldown duration.
- Blocks use during cooldown.
- Optional message feedback.

## Command
- `/pearlcooldown status | /pearlcooldown reload`

## Permissions
- `pearlcooldown.use`
- `pearlcooldown.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
cooldown-seconds: 10
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
